Close painted still life on a wet beach in morning light, low angle at sand level. A carved red-and-gold lacquered sea-chest with brass corners, its heavy lid thrown open, a hot gold glow pouring out of its depths. Soaked purple silk clings to the chest's curves and slides off its edge in a long wet ribbon to the sand, seawater streaming off it. A wave surges up the sand and bursts in foam between the chest's carved feet, rushing in and drawing back. An ornate key stands pushed deep in the brass lock. Out of focus behind, Heo's red-and-gold ship with its crimson sail in the shallows. Violet-rose #d98fa8 silk, amber #e0a33c glints on wet lacquer. Wet, open, forbidden, inviting. PAINTED STILL — no people, no figures, no faces, no hands anywhere in the frame; the place or object IS the subject. Openly erotic metaphor: the shapes, wetness, swelling, thrusting and release unmistakably read as bodies and sex, the way a frank erotic painting does — yet everything stays landscape and object, no nudity, no literal anatomy. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). Hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL: granulated wet-in-wet washes and broken-colour dabs for sky, water and stone, dry-brush texture, soft bleeding edges and a faint paper grain; oil glazes deepen the darks and a touch of impasto lands on the single brightest highlight. Romantic-painting layout: one bold shape, at least half the frame quiet negative space, distant detail dissolving into haze. Film tenebrism: one hard directional key (sun, moon or lamp) against big dark masses, a thin edge of real light along the subject, painted bokeh from small real lights. Beautiful, luminous, painterly. NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, NOT a cartoon. No text. No watermark. DAY GROUND: the frame is built on WHITE — a high-key, paper-white ground: pale bright sky, white haze and mist, sunlit plaster and pale stone dissolving into bare white paper at the edges, the shadows few, crisp and cool-grey; the figure is the dark, inked thing in a bright frame. Never a black void, never a dim dusk wash.
